Problem & intended user

Explore disaster image classification with a reproducible machine-learning workflow and an interactive demonstration.

Data & workflow

AIDERv2 imagery, ResNet50 in PyTorch, preprocessing, augmentation, class-imbalance handling, and a planned interactive application.

Design decisions

Treat evaluation and deployment checks as part of the model lifecycle. Keep training, inference, and application responsibilities separate.

Evaluation approach

Use independent data splits, per-class precision and recall, confusion matrices, and failure-case inspection.

Limitations & next steps

Document dataset limitations, verify automated tests, and publish a reproducible model and demo.
